statement: WITH t AS ( SELECT upper(split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)) AS series, upper(market_ticker) AS mkt, pnl::numeric / quantity AS p FROM paper_trades WHERE status IN ('settled','closed_sl') AND NOT coalesce(legacy,false) AND pnl IS NOT NULL AND quantity IS NOT NULL AND quantity > 0 AND assumed_price IS NOT NULL AND strategy LIKE '%mmsell%' AND strategy NOT IN (SELECT twin_tag FROM live_paper_twins) ), k AS ( SELECT series, mkt, p, CASE WHEN split_part(mkt,'-',2) = '' THEN mkt ELSE series || ':' || split_part(mkt,'-',2) END AS c_old, CASE WHEN series IN ('KXFEDMENTION','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXTRUMPSAYCOMPANY','KXTRUMPSAYMONTH','KXWCATTEND','KXWCFIRSTSONG','KXWCMENTION') THEN mkt WHEN split_part(mkt,'-',2) = '' THEN mkt ELSE series || ':' || split_part(mkt,'-',2) END AS c_new FROM t ), co AS (SELECT series, c_old AS c, sum(p) AS s FROM k GROUP BY 1,2), cn AS (SELECT series, c_new AS c, sum(p) AS s FROM k GROUP BY 1,2), ao AS (SELECT series, count(*) AS cnts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s < 0) AS losers FROM co GROUP BY 1), an AS (SELECT series, count(*) AS cnts, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s < 0) AS losers FROM cn GROUP BY 1), tr AS (SELECT series, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT mkt) AS mkts FROM k GROUP BY 1) SELECT tr.series || '|' || tr.n || '|' || tr.mkts || '|' || ao.cnts || '|' || ao.losers || '|' || an.cnts || '|' || an.losers AS row FROM tr JOIN ao USING (series) JOIN an USING (series) ORDER BY tr.series
